title: Healthy Indoor Air in Schools: Every Breath Shapes Learning
summary: A UN event co-sponsored by the governments of Montenegro, France and Eswatini highlighted healthy indoor air in schools as a public health, education and infrastructure priority. The event showcased national action on indoor air quality and globally deployable solutions for air cleaning and monitoring, with a focus on healthier learning environments and pandemic resilience.

title: REACH-OUT report finds about 27% of UK healthcare workers report Long COVID symptoms
summary: The REACH-OUT research programme found that up to 27% of UK healthcare workers reported Long COVID symptoms lasting at least 12 weeks. Female healthcare workers and those in nursing, allied-health and administrative roles were among those most likely to be affected.

title: Dr. Amy Proal and Dr. Timothy Henrich on Long COVID, Oncogenic Viruses, and the Latest Research
summary: Dr. Amy Proal of PolyBio Research Foundation and Prof. Timothy Henrich of UCSF discuss the latest research into Long COVID, including viral persistence and whether SARS-CoV-2 may have oncogenic potential.
